description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [Attach Wind with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Wedge], [Star Drive Ability Tracker] and [Star Drive Level]

description.name: Attach Wind with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Wedge
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Star Drive (0~2), removed after using Star Drive two times

description.name: Star Drive Ability Tracker
description.text: Increases Star Drive level by 1 after using 5 or 8 Wind abilities during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Wedge]

description.name: Star Drive Level
description.text: Keeps track of Star Drive level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Wedge]
